entries.value: MEGGA Real Estate: SaaS immobilier suisse AI-native, compliance-first. Marketplace publique (33k+ biens Flatfox location) + CRM transactionnel agent + pipeline LAB/KYC + portail vendeur + copilote IA + super-admin. Stack React/Vite sur Cloudflare Pages + Supabase (Postgres, 57 edge functions, RLS, pg_cron). L'IA est compliance-enabling, jamais compliance-replacing.

Les 5 objectifs strategiques (toute feature doit en servir au moins 1): 1) reduire le temps administratif, 2) reduire le risque LAB/KYC, 3) accelerer le closing, 4) augmenter la transparence client, 5) remplacer un outil fragmente.

Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind. React Router v6, React Query (+ supabase-cache-helpers), react-hook-form + Zod, dnd-kit (pipeline kanban), Mapbox GL (lazy), Recharts, Lucide, react-i18next (FR/DE/EN/IT), Sentry, PostHog. Build: tsc -b && vite build (+ postbuild overlay-storefront).

Backend: Supabase Pro (ref eayczugyrvmtqnnmvjod, eu-west-1). Postgres 15, Auth, Storage, Realtime, pgvector, pg_cron, pg_net. 57 Edge Functions Deno dans supabase/functions/. CI/CD: push main -> GitHub Actions -> Cloudflare Pages + Supabase edge auto-deploy.

Abstraction IA dans supabase/functions/_shared/ai-provider.ts: Claude (Sonnet/Haiku) cote agent, DeepSeek V3 cote public + fallback. Tracking de cout -> table ai_usage_logs. PII redaction (pii-redaction.ts) OBLIGATOIRE avant tout appel IA. Photo-vision via Claude Vision.

5 audiences gardees par PasswordGate -> StaleBundleDetector -> ProtectedRoute/SuperAdminGuard. Marketplace publique (/buy /rent /listing/:id, SearchPage+ListingPage). Compte visiteur (/account). KYC self-service (/kyc/:token). Portail vendeur (/portal/:token/*). CRM agent (/dashboard/*). Super-admin (/dashboard/admin/*).

CRM agent (layout AgentSugarLayout, dark): dashboard (TodaySugar KPI), pipeline (deals par stage), contacts (+detail), listings (+detail/new wizard/edit), transactions/:id (stepper 8 etapes + banniere KYC + offres), matching, journey, calendar (Google/Outlook), documents (+generate/templates), kyc (+:dossierId/export PDF), network, audit (journal nLPD), analytics, settings. Onboarding: /dashboard/onboarding -> /dashboard/premier-jour.

Super-admin 14 pages sous /dashboard/admin/* (accent violet, SuperAdminGuard): agencies (+detail), users (impersonate audite), monitoring, marketplace (moderation), compliance, support, changelog, feature-flags, plans, live (feed temps reel), security, nps. Silo RLS separe sur tables admin_*.

Tables par domaine: tenant (agencies, profiles, agency_profiles, agent_profiles, team_invitations); contacts (contacts, seller_leads, contact_scores); biens (properties, listings, market_listings ~33k, external_listings); pipeline (transactions, crm_offers+history, visits, client_searches, matches); KYC (kyc_cases, kyc_checklist_items, kyc_magic_links+uploads, kyc_screening_decisions, documents); portail (seller_portals, vendor_dossiers); billing (subscriptions); messaging (message_threads, messages, email_messages_cache); audit (activity_events, auth_events, platform_metrics, flatfox_sync_runs). Detail: docs/schema.md.

RLS agency-first. Agents: WHERE agency_id IN (SELECT agency_id FROM profiles WHERE id=auth.uid()). Anon marketplace: market_listings SELECT WHERE status='active'; inquiries/newsletter INSERT only. Acheteur: ses message_threads (buyer_user_id=auth.uid()). Vendeur: via seller_portals.token (stateless). service_role: edge functions, triggers ecrivent activity_events actor_kind='system'. RLS active sur CHAQUE table.

Pipeline marketplace: cron flatfox-sync-daily (0 4 * * *, 04:00 UTC) -> edge flatfox-sync (chunked self-invoke, 5 pages/chunk, rate-limit 1 req/s, lock singleton, safety >=80% vus avant sweep). UPSERT market_listings (source_id UNIQUE), photos -> Cloudflare R2 via photo-processor (photos_cf), quality_score + relevance_score GENERATED. Observabilite: table flatfox_sync_runs.

Regles perf DB (statement timeout 3-8s sur 33k rows): JAMAIS count:'exact' (-> seq scan, utiliser estimated); JAMAIS ORDER BY sans partial index couvrant le WHERE; .eq('status','active') pas .in(...) (IN ne matche pas les partial indexes); ne pas SELECT description/photos en liste (66MB). Index: idx_ml_rent_active_created (rent+active+quality>=50), idx_market_listings_tx_type_status.

Jobs pg_cron: flatfox-sync-daily (0 4 * * *) -> flatfox-sync; platform-metrics-hourly (15 * * * *) -> admin-monitoring; + automation-engine, ai-billing-monitor, weekly-report, search-alert. Declenches via pg_net http_post vers les edge functions.

Edge functions IA: ai-copilot (chat agent + actions structurees, Claude), ai-search (semantique pgvector), dashboard-ai-hint, parse-search-query (DeepSeek, public), support-chatbot. Plus extraction: extract-lead, extract-property-pdf, extract-property-url, photo-labeler (Vision). Secrets: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

Edge functions KYC/compliance: kyc-screening (Dilisense PEP/sanctions + analyse contextuelle Claude), magic-link-create/get/confirm/regenerate/send-email/upload (HMAC-SHA256), delete-account (nLPD art.32), log-auth-event (IP hashee salt quotidien), audit-pdf-export (chaine de hash SHA-256, LBA 10 ans). Validation humaine MLRO obligatoire.

Email (Resend): send-email, send-property-email, send-relance-email, send-reminder-email, send-team-invite, send-visit-email, detect-new-device. Paiements (Stripe): stripe-checkout, stripe-portal, stripe-webhook (signature STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET), admin-stripe-metrics (MRR/ARR/churn).

Media: photo-processor (R2), backfill-cf-images, c2pa-sign/verify (Content Credentials), public-staging (Gemini, rate-limit IP), virtual-staging (garde-fous LPD: Vision gate confidence>=85% + quota plan). Divers: translate-on-demand (DeepSeek + cache), deepgram-token/speech-to-text, ticket-ai-reply, automation-engine (cron), matching-engine, score-engine, search-alert, calendars Google/Outlook.

FLUX A (sync -> marketplace): pg_cron 04:00 -> flatfox-sync -> UPSERT market_listings (photos->R2, quality/relevance) -> RLS anon status='active' -> /rent via useMarketListings (partial index) -> /listing/:id -> marketplace_inquiries -> creation contact.

FLUX B (contact -> closing): lead (import IA/web/portal) -> contacts -> qualif (score) -> visits -> offres (crm_offers + contre-offres, trigger audit) -> transactions stages (lead->qualified->visit->offer->negotiation->reserved->financing->notary->signed->closed) -> gate KYC (LBA art.7, WARN non bloquant, revu MLRO) -> closing + activity_events.

FLUX C (portail vendeur token): agent cree seller_portals (token 6 mois) -> vendeur /portal/:token sans login -> RLS via token (READ property/transac, UPLOAD documents) -> updates visibles CRM -> expiry revoque. FLUX D (KYC Dilisense): transaction reserved -> kyc_cases (vigilance standard/renforcee selon montant + source des fonds) -> magic link upload (OCR, sha256) -> screening async Dilisense -> kyc_screening_decisions (PEP/sanctions) -> revue humaine MLRO -> analyse qualitative Claude (assist).

FLUX E (matching): client_searches (criteria JSONB) -> matching-engine compare budget/zones/type vs market_listings+properties -> matches (score+raisons) -> envoi agent -> alertes email (market_alerts/search-alert cron Resend). FLUX F (audit): tout changement -> triggers SECURITY DEFINER -> activity_events immutable (actor_id+kind, severity, category, metadata) -> timeline contact + audit super-admin + export PDF signe.

Compliance Suisse. LBA/KYC: kyc_cases vigilance standard/renforcee, source des fonds (crypto/mixte -> description >=20 car requise), screening PEP/sanctions Dilisense, validation MLRO obligatoire, retention 10 ans. nLPD/LPD: activity_events immutable, retention_until, droit effacement (delete-account), redaction PII AVANT IA, IP hashees. Integrite media: C2PA sur photos IA. IA = assistance/estimation, jamais automatique/garantie.

Design: minimal/transparent (Linear/Notion). Bentos rounded-xl border border-theme-border SANS ombres. Boutons style ghost (border + text-theme-secondary), JAMAIS bg-accent text-white. Badges texte colore sans fond. Modals TOUJOURS createPortal(document.body) z-[100]. Tokens theme (bg-theme-*, text-theme-*, border-theme-*). Marketplace: atoms Property X (Px*) = source de verite, ne pas recreer; tokens PX.*. Pages /design-system/* = source de verite.

Pieges critiques: Realtime -> TOUJOURS useId() pour le nom de channel (sinon crash au re-mount). formatCHF()/formatRent() type-defensive (accepte string/null), ne jamais .toFixed() sur valeur de form. Prix CHF 720'000 (apostrophe suisse). Surface 120 m2. Date DD.MM.YYYY. JAMAIS bg-white/text-gray-*/border-gray-* (cassent dark mode). Pas de any TS. RLS sur chaque table. Pas de console.log en prod. Ne pas mentionner Lovable/Claude/ChatGPT dans l'UI.

Commandes: npm run dev (vite 5173), npm run build (tsc -b && vite build + postbuild), npm run lint (eslint), npm run test:unit (vitest), test:backend, test:e2e (playwright: ai/admin/visual). Prod megga.ch actuellement password-gated (Basic Auth realm 'MEGGA — acces restreint', pre-lancement). Branche de dev courante: feature branch (jamais push direct main sans validation).

Secrets Supabase par service: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (8 fn IA), DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY, DILISENSE_API_KEY, GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY, DEEPGRAM_API_KEY, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, CF_ACCOUNT_ID + R2_* (photos). Secrets GitHub Actions: VITE_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY, VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/ACCOUNT_ID, SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN.

Docs de reference: CLAUDE.md (source de verite: regles, conventions, design, perf, etat impl), docs/system-map.md (cette carte des rouages), docs/schema.md (schema DB complet), docs/pages.md (42 ecrans MVP), docs/ai-modules.md (specs IA), docs/design-system.md + design-system-propertyx.md, docs/roadmap.md + backlog.md + CHANGELOG.md.

MEGGA AI (copilote, edge ai-copilot): bouton flottant Sparkles ghost sur toute page agent, panel slide-in. Commandes naturelles: resume ce client, redige une relance, quels biens envoyer, prepare un mandat, prochaines actions, resume les objections. REGLE: toujours nourri par les vraies donnees CRM du contact/bien/deal actif, jamais de reponse dans le vide.

Matching IA acheteurs<->biens: nouveau bien -> analyse tous les acheteurs + client_searches -> score 0-100 (budget/zone/type/pieces/surface/features) -> classe -> envoi 1 clic. Nouvel acheteur -> propose les biens actifs pertinents. Surveillance continue si client_searches.is_active: nouveaux biens / changements de prix / remises en ligne -> notification agent.

Relances intelligentes (edge automation-engine + send-reminder-email): bien envoye J+3, visite J+1 (feedback), lead inactif J+30, acheteur chaud non relance J+7, vendeur sans suivi J+14, document manquant J+3. Creent des suggestions/taches, PAS d'envois silencieux sauf si l'agent active explicitement l'envoi auto. L'agent garde toujours le controle.

Buyer Intelligence (score-engine): serieux 0-100, budget reel estime, timing (immediat/1-3/3-6/6-12 mois/long terme), proba achat 0-100, engagement very_high->dormant. Seller Intelligence: tension (calm/moderate/tense/critical), risque insatisfaction, proba accepter une baisse 0-100, urgence. Tout affiche comme 'estimation IA', indicatif.

Copilote negociation: marge (offre vs prix demande vs marche), timing (duree en vente, nb visites), strategie de contre-offre, interet probable acheteur. Generation annonces multi-versions (standard/premium/luxe/courte/reseaux) - l'agent choisit/edite/valide, pas de publication auto. Analyse objections post-visite -> visits.ai_objections, affichee anonymisee au portail vendeur.

Recherche IA conversationnelle (edge ai-search): query langage naturel -> embedding -> pgvector top-20 listings -> prompt Claude (listings + historique + contraintes) -> filtre/classe/repond -> carte + liste. Garde-fous: pas de discrimination, pas de contenu trompeur, redirige vers agent humain si offre/negociation/juridique, max 10 tours, cible <2s, disclaimer 'a titre indicatif'.

Garde-fous IA (absolus): l'IA ne contacte JAMAIS un client sans validation agent (sauf relance auto explicitement activee); ne modifie JAMAIS prix/statut/etape pipeline sans action humaine; n'envoie JAMAIS de document juridique sans validation; scores buyer/seller = 'estimation IA' indicative, pas verite; copilote negociation = suggestions pas decisions; toute action IA loggee dans activity_events avec actor_id='ai'. Human-in-the-loop obligatoire.

Score de risque KYC (calculateRiskScore dans src/lib/kycUtils.ts + edge kyc-screening): 5 facteurs - nationalite FATF/GAFI 25pts, PEP 25pts, montant >5M 20pts, PM vs PP 15pts, docs incomplets 15pts -> 0-100 low/medium/high. Listes FATF_HIGH_RISK_COUNTRIES / FATF_INCREASED_MONITORING dans src/lib/constants.ts. dilisense checkIndividual/checkEntity (PEP + Sanctions separes). Label 'estimation IA', validation MLRO humaine obligatoire.

Composants (src/components/): propertyx/ (atoms Px* = source de verite + sections/), ui/ (primitives headless + Motion: modal/dialog/Sheet/Toast/Shimmer/popover/tabs/context-menu), layout/ (ProtectedRoute, PasswordGate, StaleBundleDetector, AgentLayout, AgentSugarLayout), crm-sugar/ + crm-sugar-v3/ (shell CRM, contact detail, KYC pixel-pres, tokens dark). Domaines: search listings matching transactions kyc* documents calendar messaging portal onboarding* admin directory map ai-copilot skeletons auth-bento.

Hooks CRM (React Query): contacts (useContacts, useContactsSugar, useContactTimeline, useContactDuplicates), biens (useListings, useBiensSugar, usePropertyEstimation, useNeighborhood, useNaturalHazards), transactions (useTransactions, useUpdateTransactionStage, usePipelineSugar, useContactTransactions), KYC (useKycDossiers, useKycCase, useMarkKycCheck, useCreateKycDossier, useScreenKycCase), matching (useMatching, useExternalMatching). Adapters *Sugar = Supabase -> vues CRM.

Hooks marketplace/dashboard/admin: useMarketListings (debounce/pool), useMapPoints (lazy), useSmartSearchParser (NL->filtres), useFavorites, useSavedSearches, useMarketStats; useTodaySugarKpi, useDashboardCockpit/Funnel/Objectif, useDashboardAiHint; useCopilot, useExtractLead, useTranslatedDescription; admin useAdminUsers/Agencies/Monitoring/Compliance/Moderation, useAuditLog, useAdminLiveFeed, useSecurityAudit. a11y/ui: useFocusTrap, useReducedMotion, useMediaQuery, useSwipeNavigation, usePageMeta.

src/lib/: supabase.ts (client typé, anon key, rememberAwareStorage), utils.ts (formatCHF, formatDate DD.MM.YYYY, formatRelativeDate, formatSurface, cn), constants.ts (CANTONS, types, TRANSACTION_STAGES, FATF_*). sugarAdapters.ts (contactToCrm/transactionToCrmDeal/propertyToCrmBien). Metier: estimation, matching, kycUtils, cantonalTaxRates, plans, agencyHealthScore. Export: auditPdfExport, auditCsvExport, exportCsv. Integr: mapboxClient, captcha, sentry, posthog. Content: figma-catalog, helpArticles, listingPhotos, imageOptimizer.

Types clés (src/types/): Contact + ContactType (buyer/seller/investor/tenant/landlord/both/lead); Transaction + TransactionStatus (active/on_hold/cancelled/completed) + MandateType (simple/exclusive/semi_exclusive); KycCase + KycStatus (pending/blocking/risk/verified) + KycSourceOfFundsType; UserProfile + UserRole (agent/particulier/super_admin/dev); MatchResult + MatchStatus (suggested/sent/visit_planned/interested/rejected/ignored); Offer + OfferKind (offer/counter_offer). database.ts = types auto-generes des migrations.

Pipeline transaction_stage (ordre): lead -> qualified -> visit_planned -> offer -> negotiation -> reserved -> financing -> notary -> signed -> closed. Le passage vers offer/reserved/financing/notary/signed declenche le gate KYC (monitor_transaction_kyc_gate, LBA art.7, WARN non bloquant, revu MLRO). Offres via crm_offers (+ crm_offers_history immutable), contre-offres via parent_offer_id.

Pattern data: React Query + @supabase-cache-helpers (queryKey auto, useInsert/Update/DeleteMutation auto-invalident). QueryClient (App.tsx): staleTime 2min, retry 1, retryDelay min(500*2^n,4000), refetchOnWindowFocus, refetchOnReconnect, networkMode always. Fetch conditionnel: enabled: !!user / !!profile?.agency_id. La RLS gere le filtrage par agency (pas de WHERE agency_id explicite cote front).

Design System Property X (src/components/propertyx/tokens.ts, tokens PX.*): 100% neutres, AUCUNE couleur d'accent. Neutrals: neutral100 #FFFFFF, neutral200 #FAFAFB, neutral300 #EEEFF1, neutral400 #A4A6B0 (muted), neutral500 #464851, neutral700 #14161C (primary/ink). Font Objectivity (fallback Plus Jakarta Sans), letter-spacing -3, weights 400/500 (pas de bold). Radius: tiny 8 / small 12 / medium 16 / large 24 / pill 200. Gaps xs8/sm12/md16/lg24/xl40.

Atoms Property X (ne JAMAIS recreer, utiliser tokens PX.*): PxButton, PxBadge, PxCheckbox, PxLink, PxInput, PxAvatar, PxIcon, PxLogo, PxSectionLabel... Les 11 pages /design-system/* = source de verite ABSOLUE: colors, typography, shadows, buttons, links, badges, lists, icons, iconfonts, avatars, inputs. AVANT de creer un composant: consulter /design-system/<page> + src/lib/figma-catalog.ts (mapping node Figma -> composant React).

flatfox-sync (architecture): self-invoking chunked (5 pages/chunk, timeout ~100s, sequentiel via self-invoke), rate-limit Flatfox 1 req/s, lock singleton (anti-concurrence). Safety: >=80% des listings attendus vus avant qu'un sweep ne marque les manquants comme removed (anti-wipe). Photos -> Cloudflare R2 via photo-processor (3 variants thumb/detail/hero -> photos_cf). Tracking par run dans flatfox_sync_runs.

_shared/ai-provider.ts: abstraction multi-IA. callClaude() cote agent (Sonnet/Haiku), callDeepSeek() cote public, callPublicAI() (DeepSeek + fallback Claude). Tracking cout -> ai_usage_logs. Balance DeepSeek monitoree par ai-billing-monitor (cron). photo-vision.ts = Claude Vision (room type + quality). pii-redaction.ts scrub (AVS/IBAN/passeport/cartes/cles) OBLIGATOIRE avant tout appel IA sur du texte libre.

virtual-staging (garde-fous LPD): gate photo-vision (Claude Vision -> confidence >=85%, quality >=50/100, AUCUNE personne detectee) avant generation; prompt enrichi par Claude Haiku; image via Google AI (Gemini Nano Banana). Quota/mois par plan: starter 0, pro 50, agency 200. public-staging = version publique rate-limitee 5/h/IP. Resultat -> Storage + ai_generated_photos + activity_events.

audit-pdf-export: exporte activity_events en PDF (filtres date/categorie/severite/recherche), signe par chaine de hash SHA-256 (chaque event = SHA(prev_hash + canonical_json)) -> integrite verifiable. Conformite nLPD art.12 (tracabilite) + LBA art.7 al.3 (conservation 10 ans). Sortie {pdf base64, hash, chain_hash, count}. Front: lib/auditPdfExport.ts (jsPDF) + auditCsvExport.ts.

Storage Supabase (RLS): documents (KYC/transac uploads, CRUD par agency_id), property-photos (write agent, read public si publie), avatars (user own, public read), kyc-magic-link/{agency}/{link}/ (uploads via magic link, sha256). Photos marketplace optimisees -> Cloudflare R2 (champ photos_cf) via photo-processor.

i18n (react-i18next, src/i18n/): FR defaut eager, DE/EN/IT lazy (import() au switch). 16 namespaces: common dashboard settings contacts pipeline listings kyc messages calendar matching documents admin directory compte comingSoon auth. Detection localStorage -> browser. Switch = LanguageChangeOverlay shimmer 350ms. Garder les 4 langues synchro (skill i18n-sync).

Tests: vitest unit (npm run test:unit), vitest backend (test:backend, config dediee), Playwright e2e (test:e2e) avec configs ai/admin/visual (test:e2e:ai workers=1, test:e2e:admin, test:e2e:visual). Lint eslint (npm run lint). TypeScript strict (pas de any). Build = tsc -b && vite build + postbuild overlay-storefront (dist = site statique V3 sites/property-preview).

Supabase Realtime (pattern OBLIGATOIRE, bug A1): TOUJOURS useId() pour le nom du channel sinon crash au re-mount (StrictMode/navigation). const channelId = useId(); supabase.channel(`nom-${channelId}`).on('postgres_changes', {...}).subscribe(); cleanup avec removeChannel. Fichiers concernes (tous fixes): useAdminNotifications, useAdminLiveFeed, useMessaging.
